paper.inspection: Full22-page PDF and complete arXiv source archive checked. Tables1–5 are aggregate statistics; appendix contains cluster case-study figures. No per-SN cousin/group IDs, distance table or age-posterior bundle is supplied in the source archive.

public_related_inputs.description: Tully2015 2MASS galaxy-group catalogue; table3 group properties (25474 rows), table4 membership and table5 combined galaxy catalogue (43038 rows each). Public reference catalogue, not the TITAN-to-group crosswalk.
Public peculiar-velocity field code linked in paper; not the SN cohort or age data.
Current official release page says Stay tuned; no light-curve/crosswalk release linked.

published_diagnostic.meaning: Table3 compares scatter across group-averaged host-property splits; not a signed age–brightness slope or paired local-age contrast.

feasibility.age_discriminating_new_test: Executed conservative ZTF-host to individual Tully-galaxy crossmatch for the 401 selected ZTF–TITAN summary events. There are 56 group-member events in 54 groups, two repeated groups, and only one distinct-host cousin pair. The other pair shares a host and has no independent global-age contrast. Group intercepts, width, colour and age are rank deficient; no new slope fit is justified.
missing_for_exact_reproduction: TITAN gold/platinum selection and per-SN distance/covariance products
SN–host–Tully group crosswalk and ambiguity weights
Joint local/global age posteriors and selection metadata

scope: Bounded primary-source availability audit plus an executed public-cohort membership, age-design rank and conditional precision inventory. No author contact, exact paper reproduction or physical age-slope inference. Negative release search covers inspected primary sources, not every possible release.
